none: PAS LON-9ADDF3: Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine dating AD330-335. VRBS ROMA reverse: wolf and twins. Mint: Lyon. Reece period 17. Obverse: Helmeted and cuirassed bust or Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS [ROMA]. Reverse: Wolf and twins. Reverse inscription: None. Mint mark: -/-// PLG. Die axis measurement: 6.00. Dimensions: diameter: 17.22mm; weight: 2.45g
